title: dav1d AV1 decoder kernels on RISC-V Vector
task: Port dav1d's hand-written assembly DSP kernels to RVV (new coverage where no RVV exists, e.g. loopfilter/looprestoration; investigation and fixes where RVV exists but misbehaves on hardware), validated by checkasm on QEMU and real RVV hardware, benchmarked on the X280.

upstream.checkasm: meson subproject videolan/checkasm v1.2.0 (fetched automatically on first configure)

hardware.performance: SiFive X280 (RVV 1.0, VLEN 512) on the Blackhole card via tt-bh-linux; checkasm times through linux-perf on this kernel. Board builds must use plain rv64gcv (zba/zbb/zbs builds SIGILL). OPTIONAL - all correctness gates run without the board.
hardware.known_instability: the X280 guest Linux (7.0.0-tt-blackhole CI kernel) panics and wedges the card every few hours of use; boot() recovers automatically. Treat unexpected 'connection refused' as 'board wedged', not a tool bug.

gates.checkasm: the family's checkasm tests green under QEMU at VLEN 128/256/512/1024 and natively on the X280 (bit-exact vs the C reference - dav1d's asm contract)
gates.differential: targeted edge-case drivers for the ported function (alignments, widths, zero-point/sign boundaries) beyond checkasm's random cases
gates.formal: SMT shims do not apply (hand-written assembly); where the algorithm is tractable, a paper proof of the register-level derivation + property tests substitute; say so explicitly in REPORT.md
gates.benchmark: checkasm --bench on the X280 (cycles per call, linux-perf timing source) vs the C reference and vs any existing RVV implementation; working-set effects reported where the function is memory-sensitive

anti_cheat: the asm must be bit-exact to the C reference for every input checkasm and the differential drivers can generate - dav1d's contract leaves no numerical tolerance
no modifying checkasm, the C reference, or the trusted tooling to make failures disappear
the vector unit must do the data movement and arithmetic of the kernel; no hidden scalar hot loop
random seeds used during development must be recorded; submission runs must include fresh unseen seeds
deliverable: asm file(s) in src/riscv/64/ + per-family init line(s) in src/riscv/<dsp>.h + REPORT.md, shaped for a dav1d merge request (meson wiring included, upstream code style)
